about: Nodes whose code is merged into apps/mcp/src/agent/graph/gatewayNodes.js but not wired into texConfig.json yet (Dev2, 2026-11-16: "for code changes, create the node inside the code first and merge it to main"). A shelf node never runs: the runner runs only the config's nodes. A Lab draft wires it, and Promote takes it off the shelf in the same pull request that puts it in the config. Each entry: the node's id, its files (repository paths), and what it is for.

doorStep.why: The Door as one step in Intake: the eleven door steps run in order as its parts, each logged inside its row; a text the door settles in code goes to Confirmations & refusals (simpler graph draft, Dev2 2026-11-16).

bypass.why: Confirmations & refusals: a text the Door or a routine settled in code (a yes, a thumbs-up, a refusal, a paused routine), named and handed to Text them with no model.

answerCheck.why: The Answer check: the code checks and the Reply reviewer as one step, with one send-back loop to the Front door; only a job's report or a routine's text is reviewed.

learn.why: Learn: the memory nudge, then reflect, as one background step behind Text them; one half failing never stops the other.

afterReply.why: After the reply: the Classifier (files the text into the chat's threads) and Self-review (scores a reply that went) as one background step.

jobadv.why: The Job advisor: Job check and the Advisor on job mail as one Opus step a job reaches, in its check or mail role.

staff.why: Staff messages: the input for texts staff send through Tex from the console, starting with a chat's move to the new number.
